TREATMENT BRIEFING // GAMEPLAY GUIDE

Curing the Strain

This is the fictional treatment route inside Genome Protocol. It is not real medical guidance.

1. Reach the Secure AnnexFind a Secure Annex keycard or exploit a strain-specific route. Your main target is Sublevel Stores.
2. Recover the gene stabilizerSearch the preservation aisle in Sublevel Stores. The stabilizer is the key treatment resource and can halt active rewriting.
3. Build the right researchUse the Genomics Lab and Research Notebook. Complete Reversal needs the Replication, Human-template Retention, and Reversal Window hypotheses.
4. Return to the synthesis rigWith the stabilizer and required hypotheses, choose a treatment philosophy and execute it in the Genomics Lab.
5. Cure early for the cleanest resultEarly treatment can return you close to human baseline. Later treatment increasingly leaves residual traits or a stable hybrid body.
6. Full transformation needs an archive rescueAt terminal phenotype, Complete Reversal is locked unless you recover your pre-exposure genomic baseline from the Sealed Template Archive.
Best reversal route: collect the stabilizer, confirm Replication + Retention + Reversal Window, then use Complete Reversal. High trust with Mara also unlocks a supervised reversal route that improves the outcome window.
